The app now includes Android SIM discovery and device usage collection. Carrier billing and cloud AI are prepared in source, but are not connected. This is a test build, not a production-release certification.

Verified in this build

The tracker and owner-admin automated checks pass; see the verification report in the source package for current counts. The Android build has 10 passing native tests. The Android debug APK compiles. Android lint: zero errors, 27 warnings for release cleanup. Real-device testing and browser visual QA remain outstanding; iOS has not been compiled on macOS.

Try it on Android

  1. Download the Android test APK. It is debug-signed for testing; it is not a Play Store release.
  2. Open Connections → Detect my SIMs and grant Phone permission. No phone numbers, contacts, messages or call logs are collected.
  3. Choose Enable Usage Access, enable Telvyo in Android settings, then return and choose Read device usage. Mobile usage requires Android 10+.
  4. After access is granted, reopening the app refreshes measurements. All mobile networks are combined; OS totals are not a remaining carrier bundle balance.

Configure your MTN access

Open Owner administration with the ChatGPT account that owns Telvyo. Enter credentials as runtime secrets in ChatGPT → Sites → Telvyo → More actions → Settings, then apply the settings and refresh admin status. The admin page never accepts or returns secret values. Its supported production OAuth check verifies application authentication only; subscriber data remains disconnected until approved consent and product integration are complete.

What we need from each carrier

MTN Ghana

Obtain approved production access to Usage Management, Plans v2 and relevant subscriber profile products. Confirm Ghana field definitions, country/usage routing values, timestamp formats, pricing units, rated-call coverage and rate limits.

Application OAuth credentials are not customer consent. MTN must approve a subscriber-verification and consent process. The app must bind each signed-in customer to their authorized carrier account and support revocation.

Telecel and AT

Request partner specifications, production credentials and approved subscriber-consent flows from Telecel and AT. Public subscriber-billing APIs were not verified. A wallet or airtime reseller API does not establish access to all subscriber balances or calls.

Actual charges, not guessed tariffs

Exact call costs must come from carrier-rated records or authentic statements. Duration multiplied by a flat tariff is only an estimate; promotions, billing increments, bundles and taxes can change the charge. The MTN adapter preserves raw units and marks responses unmapped until the Ghana contract is tested.

AI and identity setup

The on-device advisor currently uses transparent statistical rules. To enable cloud AI, configure an identity provider, web/mobile sign-in, an AI provider account/model and server-side credentials. The supplied server verifies signed access tokens, requires explicit consent, accepts only an aggregate summary, and applies limits/timeouts. It has not been deployed or connected to the UI's login flow. Keep API secrets out of the mobile app.

Limits that credentials do not remove

iOS does not generally expose other apps' cellular usage, historical carrier calls or reliable automatic SIM discovery to ordinary apps. Android restricts per-SIM subscriber identifiers. Device measurements can lag and use aggregated time buckets. Carrier integrations must be validated for the exact access and fields approved for your product.

Before launch

  • Test on real Android devices, dual-SIM/eSIM setups and permission revocation; reconcile OS and carrier records.
  • Build and test iOS on macOS/Xcode; configure organization-owned signing and store submissions.
  • Complete subscriber consent/revocation, secure token storage, live API contract tests, monitoring, shared rate limits, privacy disclosures and accessibility QA.

The source package includes detailed API research, backend setup, native implementation and verification reports. No carrier has been contacted and no subscriber or AI-provider account has been queried on your behalf.
